name: resolver-dispositions
description: PF-11 RESOLVER-DISPOSITION REGISTER. Every chat-path Pax tool (a case label of executeTool in server/ai/tools.ts) has exactly one entry here, recording its resolver disposition: variant (a read-only support variant exists on the resolver path), write-pinned-absent (writes never get a support variant), excluded-with-reason (a read that must not have a variant because a pause-safe variant would bypass a permission-ladder fence), or founder-gated (the decision is parked on a named founder ruling). Enforced by tests/unit/paxResolverCoverage.test.ts, which derives the chat population mechanically — an entry naming no chat tool is STALE and fails; a chat tool with no entry and no Slice 1b named-list line fails BY NAME. This register records decisions; it is not a second authority for any fact a registry holds (the gate re-derives existence from the switches, the resolver subset, PAUSE_SAFE_SUPPORT_TOOLS and CAPABILITY_ROWS). Entries are removed only under their own revocation clause.

entries.reason: PII-LADDERED READ (BH-DEF-1.1, PR #764, auditor-verified). The chat path enforces the tenant_pii_read scope even while paused; a pause-safe support variant would skip executeSupportTool's ladder entirely (the ladder is guarded by if (!pauseSafe)) and no truthful gated placement exists in the current support classification, so any variant would be ungated, misregistered, or both.
entries.revocation: If a gated-read classification lands in the support registry (a truthful non-pause-safe read placement whose capability row can declare tenant_pii_read), build the gated variant, replace this entry with a variant entry, and delete this exclusion in the same PR.

entries.reason: Variant built in PR #738 (N9-DEF-1 cure) but unlanded: the new support case is a purpose-ledger census candidate whose DEBT entry and DEBT_BASELINE raise are Founder Decision #1, pending Tom's ruling. This entry records that the decision is the founder's; it does not decide it, and it creates no census DEBT entry.
entries.revocation: On Tom's DEBT-baseline ruling: if approved, land the variant and flip this entry to variant in the landing PR; if declined, replace this entry with the disposition the ruling directs (excluded-with-reason citing the ruling, or write-pinned-absent if the surface is retired).
